ModMetaData.name: D'thorga Emergency Dosing
ModMetaData.author: Phobos A. D'thorga
ModMetaData.description:
Doctors give painkillers and sedatives on their own.
A patient who is down or in bed and in severe pain gets the best pain relief within reach, from the doctor's pockets or the nearest stockpile. In extreme pain a sedative is given when no medical painkiller can be. Nothing is given while an earlier dose still works, while an overdose is under way, where a dose would reach a dangerous stage, or where it would leave consciousness or breathing too low.
Any mod's drugs qualify: the mod reads what each ingestible does from its own definitions (pain, consciousness, breathing, bleeding, addictiveness) and never looks for a name. Recreational drugs are never used unless you say so, and then only as a last resort.
Needs D'thorga Framework. No Harmony. Nothing is saved: safe to add or remove at any time.
